channel.title: Daily Tech Opinions Digest
channel.description: Daily curated opinion and blog posts from tech researchers and thinkers

item.title: Terry Tao: Introducing MathHelm — A Place to discuss AI-generated papers
item.description: AI is now proving theorems faster than humans can referee them, so Tao is launching a dedicated forum to discuss — and stress-test — AI-generated papers.

item.title: Sebastian Raschka: Understanding Positional Embeddings in Modern LLMs
item.description: The clearest RoPE walkthrough yet, with worked math, PyTorch code, and a survey of which positional schemes 2026's open models actually use.

item.title: Scott Aaronson: Aaronson-Ambainis Conjecture proved! (By AI, of course)
item.description: An AI just proved a 17-year-old conjecture bearing his own name — Aaronson on what it does and doesn't mean for quantum supremacy, and why he's equal parts awestruck and fatigued.
